title: brief-extension template variables
description: Values for templates/brief-extension.md.j2 and templates/brief-extension.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from brief-extension.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

audit_log_path.title: Audit log path
audit_log_path.description: Where are this feature's model calls logged for audit - the path or URI a reviewer opens? A hallucination policy with no log behind it cannot be shown to have held.

billing_owner.title: Billing owner
billing_owner.description: Who answers for this feature's spend when the hard cap is hit - the named human on the finance side, who is often not the engineering owner?

ci_width.title: Ci width
ci_width.description: How wide may the confidence interval around that pass-rate be before the measurement stops being evidence? A pass with an interval spanning the threshold is not a pass.

deprecation_window_months.title: Deprecation window months
deprecation_window_months.description: How many months of notice does the provider contractually give before retiring this model version? This number sets how far ahead the migration has to be planned.

eval_method_ref.title: Eval method ref
eval_method_ref.description: Where is the eval methodology written down - the document or path someone reproduces the number from? A pass-rate with no method behind it cannot be argued with.

factual_claim_policy.title: Factual claim policy
factual_claim_policy.description: What must happen when the model states a fact with a cited source - cite, hedge, refuse, route to a human? Write the behaviour a user would observe.

fallback_chain.title: Fallback chain
fallback_chain.description: What runs when the primary model is unavailable or over budget, in order? 'None' is a legitimate answer and is far better than an unwritten assumption.

feature_name.description: Which feature does this extension pack cover? Use the same name the base PRD uses - a second name for one feature is how the eval set and the brief stop referring to the same thing.

golden_set_version.title: Golden set version
golden_set_version.description: Which pinned version of the golden eval set gates this feature? Name a version, not 'latest' - a set that moves under you makes every past pass-rate incomparable.

legal_policy.title: Legal policy
legal_policy.description: What must happen when the output carries a legal or regulatory implication? If the answer is 'refuse and hand off', say who it hands off to.

model_name.title: Model name
model_name.description: Which model does this feature call in production? Name the model, not the family - 'the Anthropic one' cannot be pinned, deprecated or costed.

model_version.title: Model version
model_version.description: Which exact version or snapshot id of that model? A brief that names a family and not a version cannot be checked against the deprecation window below.

n_examples.title: N examples
n_examples.description: How many examples are in that golden set? This is the denominator of every pass-rate below and the thing that decides whether the CI width is achievable at all.

numerical_summary_policy.title: Numerical summary policy
numerical_summary_policy.description: What must happen when the model produces a number it derived rather than read? This is the row that decides whether a wrong figure reaches a customer unlabelled.

outlier_alert_threshold_usd.title: Outlier alert threshold usd
outlier_alert_threshold_usd.description: What single-call cost is anomalous enough to page someone? Set it low enough to catch a runaway loop on its first hour, not its first day.

per_day_hard_cap_usd.title: Per day hard cap usd
per_day_hard_cap_usd.description: At what daily spend does this feature stop serving? A hard cap that has never been set is a hard cap of infinity.

per_request_soft_cap_usd.title: Per request soft cap usd
per_request_soft_cap_usd.description: Above what per-request cost should a call be flagged but still served? This is the warning line, not the wall.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which provider serves that model - the account you are billed by and would have to file a ticket with?

threshold_pass_rate.title: Threshold pass rate
threshold_pass_rate.description: What pass-rate must the feature hold on that set to ship and to stay shipped? State the number that triggers a rollback, not an aspiration.
